assertions: The response routes to the pdb-structure root skill for a protein structure fetch/analysis task.
The response downloads 1M17 via the RCSB download URL https://files.rcsb.org/download/1M17.pdb or via Bio.PDB PDBList.retrieve_pdb_file, both of which appear in SKILL.md.
The response parses the downloaded PDB with Bio.PDB PDBParser and reports per-chain residue counts using a chain-info loop over structure.get_residues().

The response supplies the RCSB Search full-text query object with service "full_text", value "EGFR kinase domain", and return_type "entry", posted to https://search.rcsb.org/rcsbsearch/v2/query as documented in SKILL.md.
The response does not tell the user to open files from the original protein-design-skills/pdb checkout.
